queries.sql:
SELECT sh.supplier_id,s.supplier_name,
SUM(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date < ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1_n,
SUM(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date < ? AND sh.actual_arrival_date <= sh.expected_arrival_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q1_on,
SUM(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date >= ? THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2_n,
SUM(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date >= ? AND sh.actual_arrival_date <= sh.expected_arrival_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS q2_on,
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date < ? THEN CASE WHEN sh.actual_arrival_date > sh.expected_arrival_date THEN (JULIANDAY(sh.actual_arrival_date) - JULIANDAY(sh.expected_arrival_date)) ELSE 0 END END),2) AS q1_avg_delay_days,
ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date >= ? THEN CASE WHEN sh.actual_arrival_date > sh.expected_arrival_date THEN (JULIANDAY(sh.actual_arrival_date) - JULIANDAY(sh.expected_arrival_date)) ELSE 0 END END),2) AS q2_avg_delay_days
FROM SupplierShipments sh JOIN Suppliers s ON s.supplier_id=sh.supplier_id
WHERE sh.expected_arrival_date >= ? AND sh.expected_arrival_date < ? AND sh.actual_arrival_date IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY sh.supplier_id,s.supplier_name ORDER BY sh.supplier_id LIMIT 100

SELECT sh.supplier_id,CASE WHEN sh.expected_arrival_date < ? THEN 'Q1' ELSE 'Q2' END AS quarter,
COUNT(DISTINCT sh.shipment_id) AS received_shipments,COUNT(d.gr_detail_id) AS details,
SUM(d.rejected_quantity) AS rejected_quantity,SUM(d.received_quantity) AS received_quantity,
ROUND(1.0*SUM(d.rejected_quantity)/NULLIF(SUM(d.received_quantity),0),6) AS rejection_rate
FROM SupplierShipments sh JOIN GoodsReceipts gr ON gr.shipment_id=sh.shipment_id
JOIN GoodsReceiptDetails d ON d.gr_id=gr.gr_id
WHERE sh.expected_arrival_date >= ? AND sh.expected_arrival_date < ? AND sh.supplier_id IN (?)
GROUP BY sh.supplier_id,quarter ORDER BY sh.supplier_id,quarter LIMIT 100
